summary: Public-private partnership tender cancellation; scope of judicial review for state contracts; arbitrariness under Article 14; advertisement revenue rights with KMDA despite transfer of maintenance to KMC; tender cancellation based on technical ambiguity set aside; cancellation notice citing financial loss reversed; impugned High Court order upholding cancellation overturned.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; tender cancellation quashed; maintenance contract restored.
